svg.text: Layout preview · sample conditions · logical point sizes
No tiny scene; weather + snapshot launch.
No weather data where credits cannot fit.
Attribution approach: official mark + visible Legal link.
Small widget tap opens the postcard with a prominent legal link;
other families use a dedicated Link where the platform supports it.
Do not treat a tap-through as an approved attribution exemption.
Rectangular accessory needs on-device fit / provider review.
If required credit cannot remain readable, offer a launch shortcut.
Snapshots are cached, not continuously live. Show capture time;
stale or offline snapshots get an explicit age label. Never imply live.
Weather rendering is modified data; detail view carries that notice.
